page.layout: One title page. Centred title block at the top, a woodcut device in the middle, and the publisher's imprint below it. No margin text, running head or page number. Handwriting in the top right corner, to the right of the title, and at the right and bottom edges is not printed and is left out.

main_text.l: qui rationem calendarii Romani, Ægyptiaci, Arabici, Persici, Syriaci & Hebraei explicat, & intervalla præcipuarum ærarum ita declarat, ut ab Olympiadibus & Urbe condita usque ad nostram memoriam, per annos Nabonasari, Iulij Cæsaris & Christi, certa temporum series constare possit:
Autore M. IACOBO CHRISTMANNO Ioannis-bergensi, Inclyta Academia Heidelbergensis Professore.

page.notes: Woodcut device between the author line and the imprint: a winged, crowned creature (a griffin or similar beast) above a caduceus-like staff with entwined serpents, flanked by foliage and, below, birds and a pair of hands. No printed text in it. Handwriting, not transcribed: "Anning nan" (top right corner), "Mgg." / "fA. 9[?]" / "in au. I. Horm" (right margin), and "5 ff." (bottom right). Small marks above "MUHAMEDIS" are not clear enough to read and are not transcribed. The "MUHAMEDIS" line is printed as "MVHAMEDIS": V is changed to U because it is a vowel. The final date is printed letter-spaced as "M D X C", transcribed as MDXC.
